# Properties

Links in property values are indexed like links in the text: `[project plan`, `[it's`, `[plain prop`, `[related`, `[flow item` all suggest them. The comment and the block scalar above are never indexed.

Type new values in the Properties view (Live Preview) or in Source mode to check the property suggestions; see `Checklist.md`.
